session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious today. I messed up the insurance claim again, and I'm worried about the money.
I can see how that would feel overwhelming. It's understandable to feel worried when things don't go as planned.
Thanks for saying that. I just feel like I'm not good enough, and I keep making mistakes. It's so hard to do everything on my own.
I feel that so deeply. It's really hard to carry all that weight alone, and it's okay to feel like you're not enough.
You're right, it's not okay to carry everything alone. I just keep thinking I'm failing, and I don't know how to stop the guilt from taking over.
I know that guilt can feel like a heavy burden. It's so hard to quiet the voice that tells you you're not enough.
I try to tell myself I'm doing my best, but the voice is louder. I feel like I'm always falling short, and I don't know how to change that.
I hear how exhausting that must be. It's like the voice is louder than your own thoughts, and it's hard to feel like you're even trying.
Yeah, it feels like I'm stuck in a loop. Every time I think I'm getting it, something goes wrong, and the guilt comes back stronger.
It's like you're trapped in a cycle that feels impossible to break, and the guilt just keeps pulling you back down. I wish I could help you feel like you're not alone in this.
Thank you for trying to help. I feel so alone in this, like no one else understands how heavy it all feels.
I know it's hard to feel seen, but I'm here, and I care. You're not alone in this, even if it feels that way.
I know you say that, but it's hard to believe when the weight feels so heavy. I just want to feel like I can do this without breaking.
I want to believe that too, and I wish I could take that weight off your shoulders. You don’t have to do this alone.
I know you mean that, but the voice in my head keeps telling me I can't. I just want to stop feeling like I'm failing everyone.
I hear how much that voice is hurting you. It’s like it’s louder than anyone else’s, and it’s hard to remember that you’re not failing anyone.
I know you say that, but it feels like I’m failing myself. Every time I mess up, I feel like I’m proving that voice right.
It’s so painful to feel like you’re proving that voice right. I wish I could help you hear a different voice, one that sees you as more than your mistakes.
I wish that too. I just want to hear a voice that doesn’t make me feel like I’m not enough, even for one second.
